studies.name: bird-02-closed-loop-liveness
studies.description:
Compose BiRDTransportProcess with MonodCellProcess at a constant high
biomass density and measure dissolved O2 and the O2 balance to determine
that the closed loop is live, not merely wired.

studies.name: bird-01-transport-process
studies.description:
Extract the transport physics into a shared module, factor the internal
Monod term into a MonodCellProcess, and build BiRDTransportProcess; then
measure emitted deltas, contract conformance, and the standalone reactor's
trajectories to determine that responsibilities are cleanly split and
standalone behavior is preserved.

studies.name: bird-03-coupling-interval
studies.description:
Expose the coupling interval as a parameter and measure the dissolved-O2
trajectory across interval values to determine convergence behavior.

studies.name: bird-04-reactor-geometry
studies.description:
Add a selectable stirred-tank kLa correlation and measure kLa against the
published correlation to determine the model can be parameterized to a
specific vessel.

studies.name: fixed-boundary

studies.name: rigid-movable-boundary
studies.description: With barrier_kind="rigid_movable", does the wall translate at a velocity proportional to the mean contact force (drag-balance Peskin 1993 setup), and does the stall force remain bounded?

studies.name: membrane-to-actin-displacement-feedback
studies.description: Does per-step mesh-position feedback from Mem3DG to ReaDDy preserve mesh quality (no vertex inversion or degenerate triangles) and keep tip particles within their box-potential bounds?

The Millard cell's respiration (CYTBO O2 uptake, emitted as environment.exchange counts) nets additively against the reactor's gas-liquid transport at shared reactor.dissolved_o2/dissolved_co2 stores, so the kinetic cell consumes reactor O2 end-to-end.

composites.name: millard2017_metabolism
composites.description:
Standalone Millard et al. 2017 kinetic ODE of E. coli central carbon and energy
metabolism (BioModels MODEL1505110000), wrapped as a process-bigraph composite
via pbg-copasi's CopasiUTCProcess. The model has 77 species, 68 reactions, 3
compartments. Baseline composite for the v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1 study
(pdmp-01-metabolism-ode); first investigation-side use of pbg-copasi.

Calibrated reference state (per Millard 2017 Fig 2): K-12 MG1655 on M9
minimal medium + glucose, dilution rate 0.1 h^-1, pH 7.0, 37C, pO2 > 20%.
Steady-state should match the published reference fluxes within solver
tolerance.

studies.name: pdmp-01-metabolism-ode
studies.description:
Run the Millard 2017 ODE as a standalone Process Bigraph process
by wrapping the published SBML (BioModels MODEL1505110000) with
pbg-copasi's CopasiUTCProcess (basico / COPASI backend). Build
an FBA-bridge composite that couples the COPASI-driven kinetic
ODE to v2ecoli's existing multi-objective FBA solver
(`wholecell.utils.modular_fba`) so the ODE can take over central-
carbon flux predictions incrementally while the FBA covers the
rest of the network (homeostatic targets for non-central
metabolites, kinetic-constraint coupling to enzyme abundances,
NGAM maintenance). Wrap with an LQR controller that replaces the
FBA's biomass-production objective for growth-rate regulation.
Validate against the Phase 0 Xarray interface datasets across
≥3 conditions. Partition every introduced parameter as causal or
teleonomic, with written justification per parameter. A
high-performance backend (DifferentialEquations.jl / Diffrax)
is deferred to Phase 4 compilation; Phase 1 establishes
correctness through pbg-copasi, Phase 4 takes over performance.

flat, or drift as daughter EcoliWCM internal composites accumulate history?
And does running the growing colony under the process-bigraph Ray protocol
(one OS process per cell / sharded actor pool) lift the single-process GIL
ceiling colonies-01 measured (~13 cells/process at realtime)?

studies.name: mbp-07-millard-kinetic-metabolism
studies.description:
The Millard kinetic-metabolism arc, end-to-end. Can the Millard 2017
kinetic central-carbon ODE replace v2ecoli's constraint-based central-
carbon FBA as a drop-in cell engine under the cell-side interface
contract?

Three linked questions:
  1. BUILD     — does the swapped composite (baseline_millard) build and
                 run, with non-trivial live central fluxes (kinetic ODE
                 active, not FBA)?
  2. VALIDATE  — does the Millard whole-cell model recover growth
                 comparable to the FBA baseline, and (once the Millard
                 cell exposes mass-exchange accounting) close mass
                 conservation?
  3. COMPARE   — coupled to the same BiRD reactor and run against the
                 Beulig WT batch prefix, does the Millard kinetic central
                 metabolism track the bioreactor (growth, substrate, gas
                 transfer) BETTER than v2ecoli's WCM-FBA — and how do both
                 compare to the iML1515 genome-scale FBA (Palsson)?
                 Rendered as a structured 3-arm report-card comparison
                 (per-group axis verdicts + categorized divergences),
                 NOT a tolerance gate (execute-and-report, per
                 chris_feedback_2026_05_26 §10).
